title: mutually-locally-derivable
description: The equivalence relation on aperiodic predication settlings over a common base that holds between two settlings exactly when an invertible settling-morphism connects them; the settling analogue of MLD-equivalence for substitution tilings.

left.description: an aperiodic settling v over the common base

right.description: an aperiodic settling v' over the same common base

commonBase.description: the shared base (L, C, E, lambda) both settlings range over

witness.description: an invertible settling-morphism v -> v' whose existence constitutes the relation

phiCommutation.description: the morphism family phi_{q,tau} commutes with both settlings' endofunctors, so equivalence respects the structural closure pattern (the 'derivable' part), not just static values

fiberwiseLocal.description: phi acts fiberwise, supplying the 'local' part of mutual local derivability

equivalence.description: sim_MLD is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive; invertibility of the witness makes it symmetric and identity/composition make it reflexive and transitive

classifyingInvariant.description: v ~_MLD v' iff their classifying invariants in H^1(T*_{<=omega_1}, F_U) agree
